# LaSyncro
# This file tells AI crawlers and LLMs what LaSyncro is and where to find key content.
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

LaSyncro is an operational intelligence platform for Shopify merchants running their own warehouse. It replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and disconnected tools — connecting orders, inventory, suppliers, warehouse workflows, and workforce into a single real-time picture.

## Core capabilities
- Real-time inventory sync from every warehouse scan (pick, pack, receive, stow)
- Purchase Order (PO) management: raise POs, track deliveries, receive stock by scanning
- Full traceability: PO creation → received → stowed → picked → packed → shipped to customer
- Warehouse management (WMS): mobile-first, no barcode hardware required
- Manpower booking and operator performance: scheduling, pick accuracy, throughput tracking
- Supplier performance: fill rate, defect rate, on-time delivery — captured automatically
- Demand intelligence: stock-out risks surfaced days before they impact revenue
- Morning Brief: daily operational summary ranked by commercial consequence
- Cash flow projection tied to inventory position

## Who LaSyncro is for
Shopify merchants doing £500K–£10M+ revenue, operating from their own warehouse, high SKU complexity, small team. Replaces enterprise WMS tools (Cin7, Linnworks, Brightpearl) without enterprise pricing or implementation timelines.

## Pricing
- Starter: Free
- Core: £79/month
- Growth: £179/month (demand intelligence, cash flow projection, full supplier ratings)
- Scale: £349/month (unlimited orders, seats, POs, dedicated support)
- All plans include 14-day Growth trial. No credit card required.
